name: Lucillos (Spain)
description: White field within a border divided red at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Lucillos (a cross on red, a ewer on blue and a vine on white).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 8 July 2004 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 21 July 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, a white cloth with a border party per pale, red at the hoist and blue at the fly, bearing the arms at the centre when charged.
